priorReviewFindings.message: In Chromium, a normal-mode IME commit inserts text: 'stable' (revision 2) becomes 'stabl日本e' (revision 3) after CDP Input.imeSetComposition('にほん') then Input.insertText('日本'). The Vim text-input gate is checked only in the compositionstart handler (input.ts:42). The blur handler (input.ts:78-81) clears discarding during the microtask blur/refocus queued at input.ts:44. After that, compositionupdate (input.ts:49), the beforeInput isComposing branch (input.ts:185-188) and updateComposition (input.ts:152) call beginComposition() with no Vim gate, and compositionend calls endComposition() (input.ts:52), which dispatches the commit at the caret.
priorReviewFindings.requiredRepair: While the Vim hook is set and allowsTextInput() is false, no composition path may start a composition or dispatch: beginComposition() (and so updateComposition and the beforeInput isComposing branch) must not begin, and endComposition() must not dispatch. The blur/refocus that ends the platform composition must not reopen any path that commits text. Insert-mode and Vim-off composition behavior stays byte-identical. Add input-vim-hook.test.ts regressions that replay the Chromium order (compositionstart, microtask blur/refocus, compositionupdate, beforeinput isComposing insertCompositionText, compositionend '日本') and assert the document and revision are unchanged; then the VIM-40 Chromium vim-ime-normal check must pass.

designDecisionsAndRationale: Pure DOM-free Vim core under editor/src/code/vim/ producing TransactionSpecs, selection changes and host actions, because no EditorView exists and the core must be table-testable

A thin adapter (vim-mount.ts) connects the core to InputController, CodeSurface, the clipboard, eval/format actions and the live region; when off no Vim object exists and the routing order is unchanged

The pass-through set for live-coding shortcuts is checked before Vim consumption in every mode (design 3.3.1): P1 registered 'default' surface keymaps via a read-only matchesKeymap query using the platform Mod rule (Meta on Apple, Ctrl elsewhere), P2 KeyboardController shortcuts for both Meta and Ctrl, P3 clipboard and shell chords; this repairs the session-374 high finding that Ctrl-Enter/Ctrl-./Ctrl-a/Ctrl-z/Ctrl-y were swallowed on Windows/Linux
Non-insert modes consume every key outside P, including Backspace/Delete/Tab with any modifier, so KeyboardController's modifier-agnostic delete branch is unreachable there (design 3.3.3)
The text-input gate discards normal-mode composition/keyCode 229 input, and blur/refocus terminates composition (VQ5)
Cursor shape is a RenderFeedback field drawn through cursorRect, keeping renderer edits minimal

Every real session exit records an <Esc> token in the macro and redo records; dot replay always ends in normal mode with nothing pending; visual-mode changes do not start a redo record (PR-VIM-1 repair)
Search uses the JS RegExp dialect (VQ6); the desired column is measured in graphemes (VQ7); the browser Clipboard API is used without a Tauri plugin, with a graceful fallback (VQ8)
Ex :w/:q/:wq/:x/:q! are no-ops with a message; :eval/:evalall/:run/:hush/:format map vactr actions (VQ2)
intentionalTradeoffs: Visual block and hlsearch are deferred to keep renderer changes cursor-only
Replace-mode overwrite applies only on a cancelable beforeinput insertText; platforms that deliver typing only through the input diff fall back to inserting
A replace-mode IME commit inserts rather than overwrites (VQ9)
The release wasm is absent locally, so the build gate uses the debug wasm through VACTR_WASM and records that
test:style and Playwright may need the serial Opus verification step if the Codex sandbox denies the localhost bind (recorded as a verificationGap)

ciwbar<Esc>w. and dw then vjd then . redo semantics

iPad on-screen typing stays usable; Vim applies to hardware keyboards; the toggle stays reachable
